answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny hence loses 165 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the atlas decay curve is applied at close, the relic weight of every idle key falls, and the plume history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 35% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
